```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(brms)
library(kableExtra)
library(xtable)
```

```{r}
model_w_controls <- readRDS(here("Output", "Models", "model3.rds"))
table_model_w_controls <- summary(model_w_controls)
```

#### Fixed effects
```{r}
table_model_w_controls_fx <- as.data.frame(table_model_w_controls$fixed)
table_model_w_controls_fx <- tibble::rownames_to_column(table_model_w_controls_fx, "name")

table_model_w_controls_fx <- table_model_w_controls_fx %>% 
  mutate(name = case_match(
    name,
    "Intercept[1]" ~ "Threshold of attitude extremity: 1-2",
    "Intercept[2]" ~ "Threshold of attitude extremity: 2-3",
    "min_maj_scale_1" ~ "Majority-Minority Scale", 
    "min_maj_scale_sq" ~ "Majority-Minority Scale^2",
    "fr1" ~ "Framing: Yes",
    "min_maj_scale_1:fr1" ~ "Majority-Minority Scale*Framing: Yes",
    "fr1:min_maj_scale_sq" ~ "Majority-Minority Scale^2*Framing: Yes"
  ))

colnames(table_model_w_controls_fx) <- c("name", "Estimate", "Est.Error", "lCI",  "uCI", "Rhat", "Bulk_ESS", "Tail_ESS")

table_model_w_controls_fx <- table_model_w_controls_fx %>% 
  reframe(name = name,  
            B = round(Estimate,2),
            SE = round(Est.Error, 2),
            CIl_CIh = sprintf("[%.2f; %.2f]", lCI, uCI),
            Rhat = format(round(Rhat, digits=2), nsmall = 2) ,
            Bulk_ESS = round(Bulk_ESS),
            Tail_ESS = round(Tail_ESS))
```
```{r}
latex_code_table1 <- xtable(table_model_w_controls_fx)
latex_code_table1 <- capture.output(print(latex_code_table1, booktabs = TRUE))
writeLines(latex_code_table1, here("Output", "Tables", "table_for_overleaf.tex"))
```
#### Random effects
```{r}
table_model_w_controls_rf <- as.data.frame(table_model_w_controls$random)

table_model_w_controls_rf_Q <- table_model_w_controls_rf %>% 
  select(., starts_with("anti_t_laws_q")) %>% 
  tibble::rownames_to_column(., "name")

colnames(table_model_w_controls_rf_Q) <- c("name", "Estimate", "Est.Error", "lCI",  "uCI", "Rhat", "Bulk_ESS", "Tail_ESS")
  
table_model_w_controls_rf_state <- table_model_w_controls_rf %>%
  select(., starts_with("state")) %>% 
  tibble::rownames_to_column(., "name")

colnames(table_model_w_controls_rf_state) <- c("name", "Estimate", "Est.Error", "lCI",  "uCI", "Rhat", "Bulk_ESS", "Tail_ESS")


table_model_w_controls_rf_Q <- table_model_w_controls_rf_Q %>% 
  reframe(name = name,  
            B = round(Estimate,2),
            SE = round(Est.Error, 2),
            CIl_CIh = sprintf("[%.2f; %.2f]", lCI, uCI),
            Rhat = format(round(Rhat, digits=2), nsmall = 2) ,
            Bulk_ESS = round(Bulk_ESS),
            Tail_ESS = round(Tail_ESS))

table_model_w_controls_rf_state <- table_model_w_controls_rf_state %>% 
  filter(name == "sd(Intercept)") %>% 
  reframe(name = name,  
            B = round(Estimate,2),
            SE = round(Est.Error, 2),
            CIl_CIh = sprintf("[%.2f; %.2f]", lCI, uCI),
            Rhat = format(round(Rhat, digits=2), nsmall = 2) ,
            Bulk_ESS = round(Bulk_ESS),
            Tail_ESS = round(Tail_ESS))
```

```{r}
# Extract model coefficients
intercept1 <- table_model_w_controls_fx[table_model_w_controls_fx$name == "Threshold of attitude extremity: 1-2",]$B  
intercept2 <- table_model_w_controls_fx[table_model_w_controls_fx$name == "Threshold of attitude extremity: 2-3",]$B
maj_min_effect <- table_model_w_controls_fx[table_model_w_controls_fx$name == "Majority-Minority Scale",]$B
framing_effect <- table_model_w_controls_fx[table_model_w_controls_fx$name == "Framing: Yes",]$B
maj_min_sq_effect <- table_model_w_controls_fx[table_model_w_controls_fx$name == "Majority-Minority Scale^2",]$B
interaction_lin <- table_model_w_controls_fx[table_model_w_controls_fx$name == "Majority-Minority Scale*Framing: Yes",]$B
interaction_sq <- table_model_w_controls_fx[table_model_w_controls_fx$name == "Majority-Minority Scale^2*Framing: Yes",]$B

# Function to calculate cumulative probabilities for ordinal probit
calculate_probs <- function(maj_min_score, framing) {
  # Calculate linear predictor
  maj_min_sq <- maj_min_score^2
  
  linear_pred <- maj_min_effect * maj_min_score + 
                 framing * framing_effect +
                 maj_min_sq * maj_min_sq_effect + 
                 (framing * maj_min_score * interaction_lin) +
                 (framing * maj_min_sq * interaction_sq)
  
  # Calculate cumulative probabilities
  p1 <- pnorm(intercept1 - linear_pred)
  p2 <- pnorm(intercept2 - linear_pred)
  
  # Calculate category probabilities
  prob_cat1 <- p1
  prob_cat2 <- p2 - p1
  prob_cat3 <- 1 - p2
  
  return(c(prob_cat1, prob_cat2, prob_cat3))
}

# Calculate for strong minority (e.g., value of 0.9 on 0-1 scale)
strong_minority_no_framing <- calculate_probs(0.9, 0)
strong_minority_with_framing <- calculate_probs(0.9, 1)

# Calculate difference in highest extremity category
diff_extreme <- strong_minority_with_framing[3] - strong_minority_no_framing[3]
percent_diff <- diff_extreme * 100
```
